_comment: Competition classes, cheapest first. An event belongs to a class, and the
class carries the entry rules, so a whole series is re-balanced here rather
than event by event. Order matters: RaceClass.best_fit walks this list and
takes the first class that will have a car.
Three separate gates, because they stop three different things:
tier         which chassis are eligible at all
performance  a cap on the resolved performance_index, which is what stops
a fully built cheap car walking a novice class - the tier
gate alone cannot see the parts bolted to it
rating       min_rating is enforced, so a beginner is not fed to works
drivers. max_rating is NOT an entry rule: it is a
matchmaking figure for online lobbies, because locking a
rated driver out of the cheap classes strands anyone whose
rating climbs faster than their bank balance.
The performance caps are measured, not guessed. tests/class_bench.tscn
prints every car's index stock and fully built; each cap sits just above
what the best chassis of that class reaches when it is finished. The bands
overlap in tier on purpose - a built hot hatch outscores a showroom
four-wheel-drive car, and that is the whole point of tuning.

classes.name: Club Novice
classes.description: Showroom-standard starters on gentle surfaces. Free to enter, and the only class that will have a completely stock car.

classes.name: Clubman
classes.description: Built starters against showroom hot hatches. The first class where a tuning budget decides the result.

classes.name: National
classes.description: Serious club rallying: a hot hatch built to its limit, or a standard four-wheel-drive car straight off the forecourt.

classes.name: International
classes.description: Fully built four-wheel-drive machinery and drivers who know what to do with it.

classes.name: Works
classes.description: Factory-specification cars run the way a factory would run them. The last class with any limits at all.

classes.name: Unlimited
classes.description: No power limit, no sympathy. Group B and whatever else you dare enter.

classes.name: Open
classes.description: Anything that runs. Turn up in whatever you have.
